title: Cloud & Branch Connector locations and location templates: automatic creation, the default template and template settings

prose.label: Locations page.
prose.text: {{locations-page}} What the Edge locations are and what Sync does is not described {{gap:edge-locations-sync}}.

prose.label: Template settings.
prose.text: {{template-options}} {{template-ips}} {{template-bandwidth-mbps}} The bandwidth unit on the wire is open; see gap bandwidth-unit in [[cloud-connector.terraform.doc-errata]].

auto-created.statement: When Cloud Connector or Branch Connector is deployed, the Zscaler service automatically creates a location using a location template with defined attributes, and locations apply forwarding and security policies to workload traffic.

quotes: When you deploy Zscaler Cloud Connector or Zscaler Branch Connector, the Zscaler service automatically creates a location using a location template with defined attributes.
Apply forwarding and security policies to workload traffic.

location-settings.statement: A location can be configured with settings such as Firewall Control, Acceptable Usage Policy (AUP), Caution, Authentication and XFF Forwarding, and can enforce Bandwidth Control with maximum bandwidth limits for download and upload.

quotes: Configure various settings such as Firewall Control, Acceptable Usage Policy (AUP), Caution, Authentication, and XFF Forwarding.
Enforce Bandwidth Control and specify the maxiumum bandwidth limits for download and upload.

locations-page.statement: The Locations page (Infrastructure > Location Management > Locations > Cloud tab) can sync locations and sublocations, lists all locations with the scope type if configured and the number of associated sublocations, and shows information about Edge locations.

quotes: On the Locations page (Infrastructure >Location Management > Locations > Cloud tab), you can do the following:
Sync your locations and sublocations.
View a list of all locations, the scope type (if configured), and the number of associated sublocations.
View information about Edge locations.

template-required.statement: To have a location automatically created from a template, a location template must be selected when configuring a Cloud Provisioning Template or Branch Configuration Template.

quotes: To have a location automatically created from a template, you must select a location template when configuring a Cloud Provisioning Template or Branch Configuration Template.

default-template.statement: A default location template is automatically created for the organization; it can be viewed but not edited.

quotes: A default location template is automatically created for your organization. You can view this location template, but you cannot edit it.

template-name-prefix.statement: A location template's Name is mandatory, and its optional Template Prefix is contained by all locations created using the template.

quotes: Name: Enter a name for the location template. This field is mandatory.
Template Prefix: Enter a prefix for the location template. All locations created using this location template contain this prefix. This field is optional.

template-options.statement: A location template offers Enable XFF Forwarding (use of the X-Forwarded-For headers an on-premises proxy inserts in outbound HTTP requests), Enforce Authentication (require users from the location to authenticate), and Enable Caution (an end user notification for unauthenticated traffic; without it the action is treated as an allow policy), and Enable AUP (display an Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) for unauthenticated traffic and require users to accept it), which when enabled shows a Custom AUP Frequency (Days) field for how frequently the AUP is displayed to users, in days.

quotes: Enable XFF Forwarding: Enable this setting if you want the Zscaler service to use the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) headers that your on-premises proxy server inserts in outbound HTTP requests.
Enforce Authentication: Enable this setting to require users from this location to authenticate to the service.
Enable Caution: Enable this setting to display an end user notification for unauthenticated traffic. If you do not enable this setting, the action is treated as an allow policy.
Enable AUP: Enable this setting to display an Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) for unauthenticated traffic and require users to accept it.
If you enable this setting, the Custom AUP Frequency (Days) field appears. Enter in days how frequently the AUP is displayed to users.

template-ips.statement: IPS controls in a location template require a subscription to the advanced firewall SKU, and enabling one of the template's settings makes an Enable IPS Control setting appear.

quotes: To enable IPS controls, you must be subscribed to the advanced firewall SKU.
If you enable this setting, the Enable IPS Control setting appears.

template-bandwidth-mbps.statement: A template's Enforce Bandwidth Control setting takes maximum bandwidth limits for Download (Mbps) and Upload (Mbps).

quotes: Enforce Bandwidth Control: Enable this setting to enter the maximum bandwidth limits for Download (Mbps) and Upload (Mbps).

edge-locations-sync.title: What Edge locations are and what Sync does on the Locations page
edge-locations-sync.detail: The Locations page lists syncing locations and sublocations and viewing information about Edge locations as things an admin can do, and describes neither.
